component.name: DLM
component.summary: A download manager for files, torrents and streams

description.p: DLM downloads files, torrents and streams with queues, schedules, speed limits and categories. It runs a download service of its own and can also connect to one on another computer.

ul.li: Queues, schedules, speed profiles and quotas
HTTP, FTP, torrents, magnet links, HLS and DASH, yt-dlp
Looks native on GNOME, KDE, Windows and macOS
